role: Abstract base of the container minecarts (chest, hopper): an IInventory of 36 slots riding a cart, dropping its contents when broken.
scope_reason: world.conf minecarts = off: the mineshaft chest cart is built and filled but never spawned, so its slots are never read; the fill's draws are WeightedRandomChestContent's against EntityMinecartChest's 27-slot bound (that record).
